## Release — backlog-campaign v0.36.0

### ✨ What's new in v0.36.0

#### Features

- feat(pareto): score unscored ready issues on ingest ([#1550](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1550))
- feat(pareto): pareto-forge-line check beside pareto-filing-gate ([#1552](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1552))
- feat(pareto): re-score stale scores at bootstrap and every loop turn ([#1560](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1560))

#### Fixes

- fix(pareto): stop re-score newline drift, create bucket label, drop unwired create wrapper ([#1551](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1551))
- fix(stack): dispatch ignores pure row additions to APPEND_ONLY_PATHS ([#1553](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1553))
- fix(pareto): create Gitea label before add; set -e-safe re-score recipe ([#1556](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1556))

#### Other

- test(stack-parent): cover the dispatch CLI glue (targetBranch, pureAdditions) ([#1557](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1557))
- perf(reviewer): split the reviewer return contract out of worker-schemas.md (part of #1387) ([#1563](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1563))
- perf(workers): look V-codes up by grep instead of reading the table whole (part of #1387) ([#1561](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1561))
- perf(orchestrator): worker-context-report.ts measures first-turn context and spawns per merged PR (slice 2 of #1387) ([#1564](https://github.com/CorentinLumineau/blackhole/pull/1564))
